description: Deterministic construction of a v8 manifest fragment from a fixture's `local`/`incoming` spec. A record names only what the case varies; everything else is the default below, so a harness builds byte-identical manifests on every run.
ids: A symbolic key ("W-A") maps through the fixture's `ids` to its canonical UUID, written uppercase on iOS-shaped manifests and lowercase on Android-shaped ones (both platforms read either). Any other id ("mA", "annA", "x1", "q1", "s1") is UUIDv5(namespace 6b0b8f0e-6a4c-4a45-9c1c-9e6f1f2d7a10, fixture id + "/" + name).

manifest.omitKeys: keys listed here are not written at all; the string value "<absent>" on a key does the same

work.title: T
work.author: A
work.epubPreservationStatusRaw: notPreserved unless harness.preserved says true, then preserved

queue.name: Later
queue.dateUpdated: = max of its memberships' lastModifiedAt, else dateCreated

tombstone.signature: valid Ed25519 over the iOS payload (TS:48-65) by the key named in harness.trust when signatureValid, else 64 zero bytes

assets: A work naming `epub: <digest>` gets `Works/<UUID>.epub` whose bytes are the harness.assetBytes entry (a minimal valid EPUB package of the stated size whose SHA-256 is recorded as the digest label); a work naming none gets no file and hasEPUB false.
expectedNormalization: Compare normalized records: work key, lifecycle (live|deleted|absent), deadline = opClock + 90 d for a locally started countdown, epub digest label, membership rows by (queue, work) with their ids/ranks, annotation rows by id with live/softDeleted/hardDeleted/hidden, a generated parked sibling matched by provenance and note text, tombstones minted by (type, record, reason).
